question.text: The Compliance Officer of a Cat III AIF can be:

answer.text: The CEO of the Investment Manager
Any employee or director of the Investment Manager OTHER than the CEO

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per SEBI Circular dated June 24, 2022 (LVF & CO guidelines), the Compliance Officer must be a director or employee OTHER than the CEO of the Investment Manager. **The Trap:** CEO cannot double up; external consultants or CA-only restriction is not prescribed. **Cross-Exam Context:** Common requirement across SEBI-registered intermediaries (III-A, VI). **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Document the CO appointment by board resolution and notify SEBI promptly on changes.
